status: Candidate comparison specified; not a new method claim or authorized training run
question: Does conditioning an executable furniture action on its own generated decision improve the final full-room result or reduce total cost relative to the same supervision used only as an auxiliary task, with ordinary search available to both?

variables.X: Original user request, actual current scene, current views, common tools and actual past execution receipts; no teacher action, teacher rationale or future scene.
variables.D: Generated decision record; unverified until tool execution.
variables.A: One native furniture add/move/remove action or proposed STOP.
variables.I_D: 10 source units with original D; 14 other action units remain without fabricated D.

exact_objectives.auxiliary: L_aux = sum_i sum_t w_Ait [-log p_theta(A_it | X_i,A_i,<t)] + sum_i_in_I_D sum_t w_Dit [-log p_theta(D_it | X_i,D_i,<t)]
exact_objectives.conditioned: L_cond = sum_i_in_I_D sum_t w_Ait [-log p_theta(A_it | X_i,D_i,A_i,<t)] + sum_i_not_in_I_D sum_t w_Ait [-log p_theta(A_it | X_i,A_i,<t)] + sum_i_in_I_D sum_t w_Dit [-log p_theta(D_it | X_i,D_i,<t)]
exact_objectives.weights: Use archived ORIGINAL token coefficients, not newly normalized per phase. Family/component weighting, target tokens, images and training update count must be common.
exact_objectives.limitation: 14 action examples do not train D-conditioned action inputs. Keep them and report the original-D subset separately. Neither new annotations nor dropping 14 examples is authorized by this audit.

runtime_algorithm: Run the same native floor-plan stage and stage handover. Use identical asset resources and generation policy outside furniture.
At each furniture turn obtain fresh X through explicit canonical_v2 formatting. Every arm sees the same available observation types and tool schemas.
Auxiliary-trained direct policy generates A immediately. Conditioned policy first generates D until a valid closing delimiter, then generates A with that actual D. Do not inject teacher D.
Apply the same tool/schema validation and ordinary pre-execution checks, with the same cumulative tool, model-token and time accounting. Unknown physical/semantic checks stay unknown.
Execute native actions, including additions/removals, and obtain the actual next state. Invalid outputs consume the common budget; STOP is a proposal and not a success certificate.
Finalize furniture and run the common wall/ceiling stages. Evaluate the final full scene, including required assets, supported semantics, geometry, retained constraints and unresolved checks.

controls.name: ordinary search
controls.question: Can explicit task constraints and shared tools explain the gain?
controls.status: Executed only for two same-room numerical activity tasks. The current search is NOT a general full-generation baseline; rotations, addition and removal are outside its implementation.

controls.name: frozen base + same tools
controls.question: Does any learned model improve on the pretrained policy?
controls.status: Old model results exist; not a matched run with the revised inputs.

controls.name: auxiliary D supervision, direct A
controls.question: Is the extra supervision useful without generating D at deployment?
controls.status: Objective/encoder/adapter implemented; no new aligned training completed.

controls.name: same-supervision self-generated D then A
controls.question: Is test-time decision conditioning useful beyond auxiliary learning?
controls.status: Objective/encoder/host implemented; no new aligned model rollout.

controls.name: direct A with additional candidates
controls.question: Does ordinary search using the saved reasoning cost explain the effect?
controls.status: Requires measured cost-matched closed-loop evaluation. Do not force the direct arm to waste tokens generating unused D.

full_generation_evaluation.unit: Independent room/task family, not tokens, tool calls, camera views or repeated source steps. Current six development families are not held-out proof.
full_generation_evaluation.causal_contrast: Same supervision but different inference factorization. Run both quality-at-fixed-budget and cost-to-matched-quality; do not call identical target tokens equal compute.
full_generation_evaluation.primary: Joint required-object/relationship completion with geometry and existing-requirement preservation; missing objects and failed/unexecuted episodes remain in denominator.
full_generation_evaluation.secondary: Supported-check coverage, unknowns, added/removed objects, actual wall time, GPU time, model input/output tokens, candidate executions and changed geometry.
full_generation_evaluation.stop_rule: If the common ordinary methods explain the improvements, or only parser/format corrections cause the gain, revise the mechanism claim. Do not tune the old room until D wins.
full_generation_evaluation.current_missing: No independent complete-room rollout under this aligned contract; full input/asset/semantic coverage remains incomplete.
